I've been trying to process Movisens files and have been getting the following error in Part 2:
  • 1 Error in g.getM5L5 (varum, ws3, t0_LFMF, t1_LFMF, params_247[["M5L5res"]], : object 'DAYL5HOUR' not found

Thanks!

Kind regards,
